title: Indian Sausage Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired sausage wrap, perfect for a quick snack or meal. The combination of melted cheese, sausage, and wrap creates a delicious and satisfying taste experience.

ingredients.name: Sausage
ingredients.notes: Indian-style sausage or substitute with a similar type of sausage

ingredients.name: Wrap
ingredients.notes: Indian-style flatbread or substitute with a similar type of flatbread

ingredients.name: Quick cheese
ingredients.notes: Melted cheese, such as mozzarella or cheddar

ingredients.name: Syrian cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumbly cheese, such as feta or goat cheese

ingredients.name: Syrup
ingredients.notes: Optional, adds a sweet and spicy flavor

instructions: 1. Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
2. Add the sausage to the pan and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the wrap to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy and lightly browned.
4. Add the quick cheese to the wrap and cook until melted.
5. Add the Syrian cheese on top of the quick cheese.
6. Add the cooked sausage on top of the cheese.
7. Drizzle the syrup over the sausage, if using.
8. Fold the wrap in half to create a half-moon shape.
